cases.observations: Imported the interactive Beating waves test fixture with f=4.5. The Parameters panel showed No active frame before Play. Play advanced the animation; Stop left it at frame 3/15, and Cancel preview returned to No active frame without changing source. Tapping the slider previewed f=4.75. A vertical swipe beginning on the slider scrolled the panel while the preview remained 4.75; a horizontal swipe changed it to 4.6. After canceling that preview, a new 4.75 preview was applied as one source change. More > Undo restored f=4.5. Repeated Play, Stop and Cancel on this exact APK; the final source remained f=4.5.

gates: Mobile TypeScript and all 417 mobile unit tests passed. Android APK Signature Scheme v2 verified with the same single debug signer. adb install -r preserved the isolated app data. The 513-line scoped process log had no filtered fatal exception, AndroidRuntime, React Native JS error, ANR or fatal signal match.
scope: This verifies TP13 on the isolated Notes Check package on one Samsung phone. It does not certify the internal or release package.
